# Sourcery Documentation

> Sourcery is a Python LLM extraction framework for converting text, PDFs, URLs, HTML, and VLM OCR image sources into typed, source-grounded Pydantic data with JSONL and HTML review workflows.

Sourcery is a Python LLM extraction framework for converting unstructured text, PDFs, URLs, HTML, and VLM OCR image sources into typed, source-grounded Pydantic data with async extraction, streaming chunk events, traceability, and reviewable output.


## Getting Started

- [Home](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/index.md): Documentation home for schema-first LLM document extraction.
- [Installation](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/getting-started/installation/index.md): Install Sourcery, optional extras, and provider credentials.
- [Quickstart](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/getting-started/quickstart/index.md): Run typed LLM extraction with JSONL and HTML outputs.

## Guides

- [Build a Pipeline](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/guides/build-a-pipeline/index.md): Mixed-source extraction pipeline workflow.
- [Code Examples](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/guides/code-examples/index.md): Runnable Python examples for extraction, ingestion, streaming, IO, and benchmarking.
- [Usage](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/guides/usage/index.md): End-to-end Sourcery usage reference and API patterns.
- [Runtime and Tuning](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/guides/runtime-and-tuning/index.md): Runtime controls, async extraction, streaming, retries, and tuning profiles.
- [Ingestion](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/guides/ingestion/index.md): Load text, PDFs, URLs, HTML, and VLM OCR image sources.
- [Outputs and Reviewer](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/guides/outputs-and-reviewer/index.md): JSONL persistence, HTML viewer, and reviewer workflows.
- [Benchmarking](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/guides/benchmarking/index.md): Benchmark CLI usage and output format.
- [Testing and Validation](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/guides/testing-and-validation/index.md): Test, lint, and type-check commands.

## Architecture

- [System Overview](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/architecture/system-overview/index.md): Module boundaries and execution flow.
- [Pipeline Internals](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/architecture/pipeline-internals/index.md): Chunking, alignment, merge, and prompt internals.
- [Runtime Internals](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/architecture/runtime-internals/index.md): Engine/runtime orchestration internals.

- [Public API](https://jolovicdev.github.io/sourcery/reference/public-api/index.md): Public exports, top-level API surface, and streaming entry points.
